prompts.q: choose the daily summaries dataset and enter boulder as the search term
set the dataset to global summary of the month
search for zip codes instead of stations
pick the daily summaries dataset, set search for to cities and enter denver as the search term
how many items are in the cart
prompts.check: (card) => { const t = [card.title, card.sub, card.answer, ...(card.rows || [])].join(" "); return [/\b0 items|\bzero\b|\bno items|\b0\b/i].filter((r) => r.test(t)).length >= 1; }

prompts.q: what identifiers can I use when searching for stations
prompts.check: (card) => { const t = [card.title, card.sub, card.answer, ...(card.rows || [])].join(" "); return [/WBAN/i, /GHCND/i, /FAA/i, /ICAO/i, /NWSLI/i, /COOP/i].filter((r) => r.test(t)).length >= 3; }

prompts.q: what does the date range default to
prompts.check: (card) => { const t = [card.title, card.sub, card.answer, ...(card.rows || [])].join(" "); return [/latest available year/i].filter((r) => r.test(t)).length >= 1; }
